title: MOXIR — documents (maker manuals, order, patch, sketches, research, scans)
licenceNote: Maker manuals and datasheets are the makers' copyright, kept as internal reference for the production team; never public. Everything else was made by the studio's own di.iiii tools or by the studio; the hall's own photographs are in the project moxir-sources.
notes: Left out on purpose: .diiii backups, rigbuilder packs and tar.gz (copies of whole spaces or builds), screenshot evidence folders of the tools (moxir-hall, -halo, -xflat, -the-cut, -realism, -dark, -smart-view, -phone-fix, -visualiser, rig-equipment rigequip-*.png and media/), the frame dumps inside moxir-show sub-folders, hall photographs (already in moxir-sources; the originals are an add-sources --originals job), and the scan runs' image copies (frames, images.tar, parts) which duplicate those photographs.
